preparation_audit.scope: Archived environment/startup case-outcome records are separate from current merged-queue attempt categories and final per-subject fit outcomes. No summed algorithm-failure count.

rules.range: Min/max of available subject measurements (or same-subject ratios)
rules.stage: Conditional on fresh official norm/aseg/wmparc, official preprocessing excluded
